answer: Each claim must dock at a harbor built only from its own verified jobs, paying 80 POA burned to berth. The harbor sits on a river whose current is set by the last close hash, and each crossing waits for the next close hash, so 10 clones need 10 epochs instead of flooding in together. A comet crosses once per epoch and peers read its bright trail against the ledger — a copied claim shows no trail and is turned away with its 80 POA burned. One harbor berths one claim per epoch and cannot be shared across identities.
